purpose_context: felix-admin-capture's workspace files have procedural material leaked across them and a user context that is not scoped to the capture role. This mission cleanly separates SOUL (voice/stance), USER (filtered person-view), and TOOLS (actual tool surface) per the #587 file-ownership standard, then reconciles and deploys to office2 with a smoke test. It is a pure refactor: capture's behavior is unchanged, and all routing-intelligence work is deferred to #651.
purpose_tldr: Re-author capture's SOUL/USER/TOOLS into a clean, self-contained set against the #587 standard with no behavior change.
